fact: On 15 July 2022 the education ministry launched the pilot phase of a unique learner identification project, with online enrolment and school ID cards, in the provinces of Boulgou and Kourwéogo, to begin in the 2022-2023 school year with national roll-out possible in 2024.
title: Burkina/Éducation: le projet d'identification unique des élèves lancé
